If your dispute about a payment you actually made is rejected, a handling fee of 80,000 VND applies, as stated in (fee_schedule#4.1). The bank will explain the reason for the rejection and reverse the provisional credit within 5 working days, as mentioned in (dispute_policy#4.5).

According to the policy, you have 60 days from the payment date to report an unauthorized payment. If you report it within this period, you are not liable for the amount. If you report it after 60 days, the bank will review your case individually, and you may be liable for the amount. 

For more details, refer to (dispute_policy#3.1) and (card_terms#4.2).

As per the policy, the bank refunds the amount as a provisional credit within 5 working days for an unauthorized payment while it investigates. (dispute_policy#4.2) If the dispute is accepted, the provisional credit becomes final. If it is rejected, the bank explains why and the provisional credit is reversed with 5 working days' notice. After entering 5 wrong OTPs, the card's online payments will be paused for 30 minutes (authentication_rules#4.2). During this time, you cannot make any online payments. If you need to resume payments, wait for the 30-minute period to end.

For a single transfer in the app, a biometric check is required for transfers of **10,000,000 VND or more**. This is specified in the authentication rules (authentication_rules#2.1).
